messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "shake oral suspension bottle well for at least 20 seconds before each use"
set: ["shake oral suspension bottle well for at least 20 seconds before each use", "shake the bottle before each use", "shake bottle vigorously for 5 to 10 seconds prior to each use", "shake the bottle well before every dose", "shake the oral suspension", "shake oral suspension before measuring a dose", "shake oral liquid well before every dose", "shake the oral suspension (liquid)", "shake the oral suspension (liquid) before you measure a dose", "may also need to shake your albuterol device just before each use", "must be shaken before each use", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "attach a new needle before each use", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "use new needle for each injection"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "shake the bottle before each use",
    "shake bottle vigorously for 5 to 10 seconds prior to each use",
    "shake the bottle well before every dose",
    "shake the oral suspension",
    "shake oral suspension before measuring a dose",
    "shake oral liquid well before every dose",
    "shake the oral suspension (liquid)",
    "shake the oral suspension (liquid) before you measure a dose"
  ],
  "alias": "shake oral suspension bottle well for at least 20 seconds before each use"
}
